integrity: The q=5 count of forty length-two elements is explicitly credited to Sangare and Ta (2026). The new mathematical claim is an arbitrary-characteristic-five-field criterion and the extension-field census and geometric interpretation. The argument has not received independent auditing.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns R_5 over coefficient fields of characteristic five; extension-field direct experiments corroborate the formula but do not enumerate all pairs, and no claim is made for other orders or characteristic.
title: Quadratic discriminants govern modular dihedral quandle commutators
